title: Formal and Informal Partners
text:
Collocations also differ in register. A speaker may say that they are going to call off a meeting in conversation, but a formal report would more likely state that the meeting was cancelled. The same underlying idea can therefore be expressed through very different word partnerships. Writers who ignore this difference risk sounding either stiff or careless.

The choice is seldom about correctness alone. A phrasal verb can be perfectly clear and still feel inappropriate in an academic abstract. Many style guides therefore recommend one-word verbs, such as postpone instead of put off, when the audience expects precision. Nevertheless, the best writers do not avoid informal language entirely; they use it deliberately.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what would a formal report more likely say?
options: That the meeting was called off
That the meeting was put off forever

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do many style guides recommend?
options: One-word verbs, such as postpone instead of put off

questions.text: What can be inferred about phrasal verbs in academic writing?
options: They may be clear but still sound inappropriate in some contexts
They are always the most precise option
They are used only in speech

questions.text: What does the writer suggest about the best writers?
options: They rely on style guides alone

vocabulary.definition: the level of formality used in a particular kind of language
following accepted rules of language and behaviour
to arrange for something to happen at a later time
done on purpose and with thought

paragraph_translations: צירופי מילים שונים גם ברמת הסגנון. דובר עשוי לומר בשיחה that they are going to call off a meeting, אבל דוח רשמי יאמר כנראה שהפגישה בוטלה. לכן אותה רעיון בסיסי יכול להתבטא בשיתופי מילים שונים מאוד. כותבים שמתעלמים מההבדל הזה מסתכנים בהישמע נוקשים או רשלניים.

הבחירה נוגעת לעיתים רחוקות לנכונות בלבד. פועל מורכב יכול להיות ברור לחלוטין ועדיין להרגיש לא מתאים בתקציר אקדמי. לכן מדריכי סגנון רבים ממליצים על פעלים של מילה אחת, כמו postpone במקום put off, כאשר הקהל מצפה לדיוק. עם זאת, הכותבים הטובים ביותר אינם נמנעים לחלוטין משפה לא רשמית; הם משתמשים בה בכוונה.
